segments.caption: Back to back.
RCB are champions again.
But this was no fluke. We ranked every team on 30 numbers, and found the secret.
Run rate, dot balls, boundaries, sixes and wickets. In the powerplay, the middle overs and at the death. With the bat, and with the ball.
Most teams averaged between 5th and 7th. RCB averaged 3.5. Nobody was close.
Now plot every team. How fast they scored, against how fast they conceded.
Punjab, Sunrisers and Rajasthan could hit. But they leaked runs.
Gujarat and Kolkata were tight with the ball, but slow with the bat.
Only one team scored faster than average, and conceded slower than average. RCB. Alone in the corner.
Start with the powerplay. Only two teams hit fewer sixes there than RCB.
But they faced the fewest dot balls in the league. One ball in three. The average team? More than four in ten.
The scoreboard never stopped moving.
Then they shifted gears. Second for run rate in the middle overs. Second at the death.
And here's the secret. At the death, they lost just 1.3 wickets an innings. The league lost almost 2.
Virat Kohli. 675 runs, at a strike rate of 166. At 37, the fastest season of his IPL life.
Rajat Patidar struck at 193. Only two batters with 400 runs went faster.
With the ball, the damage came early. 2.25 wickets in every powerplay. The most in the league.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar led it. 28 wickets, at under eight an over.
And at the death, they slammed the door. Only one ball in five went for a boundary. No team was harder to hit.
Their one weak spot? Middle-overs bowling. 7th for wickets.
But when you strike early and finish strong, the middle stops mattering.
So what changed from last year? In 2025, RCB won with the ball. In 2026, the bat took a leap.
Run rate, up from 9.7 to 10.5. Dot balls, down. Runs per wicket, up from 32 to 36.
Same bowling. Better batting. A better team.
It wasn't always smooth. Ten games in, they were 6 and 4, after back-to-back defeats.
Then they won 5 of their last 6.
7 chases won, out of 9. Gujarat, crushed by 92 runs in Qualifier 1. Then beaten again in the final.
Not the biggest hitters. Not the deadliest bowlers.
Just a team with no weak phase. That's how you win it twice.
Beyond The Scoreboard.
